status: Amendment 7 experiment 7, exploratory, post hoc; criteria in exp7_criteria.json written before computing

criteria.status: written before any experiment 7 statistic was computed; exploratory, post hoc, changes no preregistered decision
criteria.already_known_when_written: results/revision/eval: b2mixed Older-clean within-drug AUROC 0.452 (tier A) and 0.397 (tier B); exploratory additive residual 0.405; DrugBank lookup Older-clean within-drug 0.641 (tier A). No feature-level statistic below had been computed.
criteria.primary_system: b2mixed-biomedbert names-only input (oodold_empty), P(interaction) averaged over seeds 42, 1, 2, 3, 4, used as logit
criteria.cohort: Older-clean (1,832 pairs, 128 drugs); Novel reported alongside where stated
criteria.tiers: tier A (FDA labels) and tier B (FDA and DrugBank agree) are co-primary; a cause is confirmed only if the rule holds on both tiers, and is reported as tier-specific if it holds on one

statistics.feature_auroc: within-drug AUROC of the feature against the label, two-way cluster bootstrap over OOD drugs and partners (1,000 draws, seed 42), 95% percentile interval
statistics.score_feature_association: within-drug Spearman: score and feature ranked within each drug, demeaned within drug, pooled Pearson correlation; 95% interval from a drug-cluster bootstrap (1,000 draws, seed 42)
statistics.partialling: within-drug OLS slope of the demeaned model logit on the demeaned feature; the model's within-drug AUROC is recomputed on logit minus slope times feature; the gap is |AUROC - 0.5|

generic_rule_for_features_a_b_c_e.C1: the feature's within-drug AUROC 95% interval excludes 0.5
generic_rule_for_features_a_b_c_e.C2: the score-feature association 95% interval excludes 0, with the sign that pushes the model below chance: sign(association) x (feature AUROC - 0.5) < 0
generic_rule_for_features_a_b_c_e.C3: partialling out the feature moves the model's within-drug AUROC toward 0.5 by at least half of its gap
generic_rule_for_features_a_b_c_e.confirmed: C1, C2 and C3 all hold
generic_rule_for_features_a_b_c_e.partial: C1 and C2 hold but C3 does not

a.name: partner frequency in SemEval train
a.feature: log(1 + number of SemEval train pairs that contain the partner); partner SemEval train positive rate is reported beside it as a secondary feature without a decision
a.expected_if_true: feature within-drug AUROC below 0.5 and model score positively associated with it
a.rule: generic rule, with C1 requiring the interval to lie below 0.5

b.name: popularity of each partner among other drugs' positives
b.feature: leave-one-drug-out count of positive pairs for the partner in the same cohort; the leave-one-drug-out positive rate is the partner-only prior of item (iii)
b.expected_if_true: feature within-drug AUROC below 0.5 (negatives reuse partners that are positives for other drugs) and model score positively associated with it
b.rule: generic rule, with C1 requiring the interval to lie below 0.5

c.name: partner token count and tokenization
c.feature: number of BiomedBERT WordPiece tokens in the partner name (primary); whitespace word count reported beside it
c.expected_if_true: feature AUROC away from 0.5 and model association in the direction that pushes it below chance

d.name: label-noise asymmetry
d.test: model within-drug AUROC on tier B versus tier A; also the within-drug AUROC of the model separating DrugBank-contradicted FDA negatives (DrugBank lists them) from DrugBank-confirmed FDA negatives
d.confirmed: tier B point estimate is closer to 0.5 than tier A by at least half of the tier A gap AND the tier B 95% interval contains 0.5
d.rejected: tier B point estimate is as far from 0.5 as tier A or further

e.name: shared name stem or suffix (exploratory)
e.feature: 1 if the OOD drug and the partner share a class stem from a fixed list (azole, statin, tinib, navir, olol, pril, sartan, mab, cillin, cycline, floxacin, prazole, dipine, triptan, setron, gliptin, gliflozin, parin, vir, profen, oxetine, afil, caine, barbital, azepam, conazole, mycin) or a common suffix of 4 or more characters after salt words are removed

other_items.i: paired within-drug differences, b2mixed minus Qwen names-only and b2mixed minus DrugBank lookup, Older-clean and Novel, tiers A and B, shared two-way draws (Novel seed 1042, Older seed 42 as in evaluate2); DrugBank on tier B is circular by construction
other_items.ii: knowledge ceiling: within-drug AUROC of a scorer that outputs DrugBank listing exactly (ties kept), tier A, with the analytic pooled value 0.5 x (1 + c - r), c = share of FDA positives DrugBank lists, r = share of FDA negatives DrugBank lists
other_items.iii: partner-only prior: leave-one-drug-out partner positive rate within Older-clean, within-drug AUROC, tiers A and B
other_items.iv: confidently wrong: share of negatives with P(interaction) above 0.5 and above 0.9, OOD versus SemEval test; ECE with 10 equal-width bins beside it
other_items.year: descriptive only: per-drug within-drug AUROC on continuous first approval year, weighted by the drug's number of pairs, Novel and Older-clean drugs together, drug bootstrap (1,000, seed 42); slope per decade; the 2013 to 2019 gap and the label-format difference between cohorts make it weak

criteria.dropped: same-ATC class and pair co-mention in SemEval train are not tested as causes (outside the constrained list; OOD drugs are absent from SemEval by construction, so co-mention is zero for every non-leaked pair); calibration slope, intercept and max-probability OOD detection are replaced by item iv
